ideas.pitch: An AI-powered maintenance ticket triage and routing platform specifically tailored for university campuses like VIT Bhopal, leveraging speech-to-text and image analysis to categorize and prioritize hostel complaints instantly.
ideas.title: CampusPulse AI: Automated Hostel & Infrastructure Ticketing Copilot
ideas.why_it_could_win: University-hosted hackathons with university club organizers deeply appreciate solutions that solve immediate, visible campus pain points. Judges will instantly relate to hostel and maintenance issues.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight web-extension and desktop helper that detects multi-person audio anomalies and abnormal tab-switching patterns during online assignments without violating student privacy through video recording.
ideas.title: ExamShield: Localized Proctoring & Audio Anomaly Detector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines practical utility for academic institutions with clever edge-case engineering, fitting the Metaversity Club's focus on tech-driven educational solutions.

ideas.pitch: An offline-first progressive web app for campus food outlets that handles peak-hour rush queues and peer-to-peer digital token syncing even when university Wi-Fi drops.
ideas.title: ViteCafé: Low-Latency Offline-First Canteen Ordering & Inventory P2P
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the exact bottleneck every student faces during overnight hackathons—canteen queues—and demonstrates robust real-world engineering rather than just UI mockups.

ideas.pitch: An augmented reality web app that revitalizes traditional Indian games like Rumal Chori and Chupan Chupai by overlaying geo-fenced digital clues and collectibles across the VIT Bhopal campus grounds.
ideas.title: MetaEvent: AR Campus Treasure Hunt & Nostalgia Game
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly nods to the hackathon's own description mentioning old-school games and the Metaversity Club, guaranteeing high engagement and delight from the judging panel.

ideas.pitch: A smart developer companion tool that runs in the background of a 24-hour hackathon, automatically capturing git commits, terminal outputs, and quick voice notes to generate a polished final project demo page and pitch script.
ideas.title: ScribeMeet: Overnight Hackathon Auto-Doc & Progress Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Meta-hackathon tools are loved by judges because they address the exhaustion and rush of overnight coding sprints, ensuring teams present polished outputs regardless of sleep deprivation.
